# Lute provenance

This directory contains the complete source of Lute v1.7.6 from:

https://github.com/88250/lute/tree/v1.7.6

The release resolves to commit `1f5951d8baaa29542bfa7c41415f4d68fa040202`.
`javascript/lute.min.js` is generated from this source by
`scripts/build-lute.mjs` using Go 1.19.13 and GopherJS v1.19.0-beta2.
